verdict.rationale: sevDesk documents a REST API and a full OpenAPI spec that expose bookkeeping data. Those are developer building blocks that someone could use to build an affordability agent, not a shipped capability that answers "can we afford X?" questions. Nothing in the evidence shows a first-party AI assistant, an MCP server, or agent-facing affordability or cash-position answers, and the llms.txt probe returned 404.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can ask an agent "can we afford X?" and get an answer grounded in live ledger data pulled through the API
